SELECT S. ID, S.PARK_ID, SV.VISITOR_PHOTO_ID AS PHOTOID, S.PERSON_NAME, S.AREA_NAME, S.EVENT_TYPE, S.SNAP_TIME, SV.COMPANY, S.PERSON_PHONE, S.SNAP_PHOTO_ID, S.PERSON_TYPE, S.CREATE_TIME, S.DEVICE_ID, dev.DEVICE_NAME FROM SMT_SNAP_PERSON S LEFT JOIN SMT_VISITOR SV ON S.PERSON_ID = SV. ID LEFT JOIN SMT_DEVICE dev ON S.DEVICE_ID = dev.ID
S.ID = #{query.id}

SELECT s. ID, s.PARK_ID, sf.FELLOW_PHOTO_ID AS photoId, s.PERSON_NAME, s.AREA_NAME, s.EVENT_TYPE, s.SNAP_TIME, SV.COMPANY, s.PERSON_PHONE, s.SNAP_PHOTO_ID, s.person_type, s.DEVICE_ID, dev.DEVICE_NAME FROM SMT_SNAP_PERSON s LEFT JOIN SMT_FELLOW_VISITOR sf ON s.PERSON_ID = sf. ID LEFT JOIN SMT_VISITOR sv ON sf.VISITOR_ID = sv. ID LEFT JOIN SMT_DEVICE dev ON s.DEVICE_ID = dev.ID
S.ID = #{query.id}

SELECT s. ID, s.PARK_ID, sf.FELLOW_PHOTO_ID AS photoId, s.PERSON_NAME, s.AREA_NAME, s.EVENT_TYPE, s.SNAP_TIME, SV.COMPANY, s.PERSON_PHONE, s.SNAP_PHOTO_ID, s.person_type, s.DEVICE_ID, dev.DEVICE_NAME FROM SMT_SNAP_PERSON s LEFT JOIN smt_admittance_fellow sf ON s.PERSON_ID = sf. ID LEFT JOIN smt_admittance_apply sv ON sf.VISITOR_ID = sv. ID LEFT JOIN SMT_DEVICE dev ON s.DEVICE_ID = dev.ID
S.ID = #{query.id}

SELECT s. ID, S.PARK_ID, st.FACE_PIC_ID AS photoId, s.PERSON_NAME, st.BADGE AS staffBadge, st.COMP_NAME, st.DEP_NAME, st.JOB_NAME, st.JCHE_NAME, st.STATUS AS staffStatus, s.AREA_NAME, s.EVENT_TYPE, s.SNAP_TIME, s.PERSON_PHONE, s.SNAP_PHOTO_ID, s.person_type, s.DEVICE_ID, dev.DEVICE_NAME FROM SMT_SNAP_PERSON s LEFT JOIN SMT_STAFF st ON s.PERSON_ID = st. ID LEFT JOIN SMT_DEVICE dev ON s.DEVICE_ID = dev.ID
S.ID = #{query.id}

select min(AREA_ID) AREA_ID,min(AREA_NAME) AREA_NAME,count(*) count,EVENT_TYPE from SMT_SNAP_PERSON where
PARK_ID=#{parkId} and
CREATE_TIME BETWEEN trunc(sysdate) and trunc(sysdate+1) GROUP BY AREA_ID,EVENT_TYPE
